clips.title: The story
paras: Tradesmen's Terrace is the bustling commercial heart of Darnassus, situated along the city's southern flank. It brings together craftspeople, merchants, and the local auction house beneath the sweeping wooden architecture of the night elf capital. The terrace serves as the primary trade link connecting artisans with adventurers journeying across Teldrassil and beyond.

Occupying the southern stretch of Darnassus, Tradesmen's Terrace houses the capital's mercantile life. While much of the city is devoted to quiet contemplation, wilderness sanctuaries, and spiritual duties, this terrace brings together shopkeepers, tradespeople, and merchants serving both local kaldorei and travelers from the wider Alliance. It contains Darnassus's central auction house, general provisions, and crafting supply stores, making it the essential staging ground for journeys into the wilds. Broad footpaths connect it northward directly to the Warrior's Terrace and westward toward the serene waters of the Temple Gardens and the grand Temple of the Moon.
